$schema_note: EventSignal schema for marketing/events/*.json — one file per public event relevant to HydraShield. BINDING: events are recorded only from the official event/organizer page, live-checked at date_checked. No invented attendance, no invented exhibitors, no invented dates.

date.note: start date or date range as published (e.g. '2026-10-14' or '2026-10-14..2026-10-16')

relevance_reason.note: why this event matters for HydraShield, tied to the event's published scope
